description: This file defines a Panel interface and its implementation for managing user settings panels in a Mattermost plugin, including creating, displaying, and cleaning up setting posts.

classes.name: panel
classes.description: Implementation of the Panel interface managing user setting panels, including creation, display, and cleanup.

methods.name: NewSettingsPanel
methods.description: Constructor function to create a new Panel with provided settings, poster, logger, store, and URLs.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a specific setting value for a user.

methods.name: GetSettingIDs
methods.description: Returns the list of setting IDs.

methods.name: URL
methods.description: Returns the URL or handler for the panel.

methods.name: Print
methods.description: Creates and sends a direct message with the current settings to a user.

methods.name: ToPost
methods.description: Generates a post object representing the current settings panel.

methods.name: cleanPreviousSettingsPosts
methods.description: Deletes previous setting posts for a user.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the panel by cleaning previous posts.

methods.name: isSettingDisabled
methods.description: Determines if a setting is disabled based on its dependency.
